lastDone.summary: Audited and enhanced complete Store/Materials toolbar suite (+ Add Material, ⚡ Fast Entry, 🏭 + Plant Section, ⚙️ + Machine/Roll, 📁 + Category, 📊 Export Excel, 📤 Upload Excel, 📥 Template) and overhauled A3 Official Invoice & SIV Voucher Generator: 1) Eliminated all hardcoded mock fields (Shifa Pharmacy, hardcoded 7.00 discount qty, fake 2113.09 scheme discount, hardcoded 5% tax slab, and dummy SBI bank details). 2) Replaced with 100% dynamic DB system settings, real recipient department & plant section mapping, multi-slab dynamic GST computation (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%), official Sri M.K. Paper Mills bank accounts, and industrial paper mill store terms. 3) Multi-agent validation passing 45/45 assertions across all 6 core agents with 100% data integrity.

storeManagement.inwardDesk: Fully operational with fast GRN entry, auto-scroll to desk on tab click, printable A3 GRN invoice (logo+watermark), full DML (PUT/DELETE with stock reversal), 1-click gate-pass import now a searchable dropdown, and GRN header (vehicle/challan/invoice number) now editable via the same Edit modal with its own status guard (blocked on Closed/Cancelled)
storeManagement.outwardDesk: Fully operational with live stock availability verification, printable SIV slips, full DML (PUT/DELETE with stock restore), negative-stock guarded, and automatic Digital Twin asset provisioning
storeManagement.indentRequests: Unified view connecting all multi-item department indents (indents & indent_items) with item count, total quantity, status badges, direct issuance, + Raise Store Indent desk button, Edit modal, and full DML permanent deletion with atomic cascading cleanup.
storeManagement.approvals: Live synchronized queue for Submitted, L1 Approved, and Approved indents with 1-click approval, serial/batch issue picking, rejection, and full DML deletion options.
storeManagement.departmentConsumptionShare: Multi-view visualizer (Bars, SVG Donut, Detailed Data Table, Ranked Leaderboard) with real-time searchbar filter, sorting by valuation/qty/indents, and instant drill-down hyperlinks connecting directly to store vouchers.
storeManagement.systemBackupAndMigration: Full project backup bundle (mkmill_complete_backup.zip, 26.68 MB) + PostgreSQL data dump (db/backups/mkmill_complete_dump.sql) with 1-click restore engine (scripts/restore_db.js, setup_new_system.bat) and MIGRATION_GUIDE.md verified with 100% data fidelity.
storeManagement.departmentReports: Confidential — Store Manager (role_level<4) sees own department only; admin/Plant Head (role_level>=4) sees org-wide. 6 tabs: Department Summary, Item-Wise, Category/Subcategory, Bin/Rack Location, Vendor-Wise, Fast/Slow/Dead Stock — all with drill-down, print-ready. Live verified with test JWTs.
storeManagement.excelSync: Automated sync for all 7 store categories + inward GRN transactions strictly by material code without naming assumptions
storeManagement.stockLedgerReconciliation: Corrected 2026-08-20: indent-issue was writing a stale pre-deduction balance into stock_ledger (now fixed), warehouse transfer dispatch/receive wrote ledger rows without updating materials.current_stock (now fixed, both routes). Earlier 'reconciled, 0 drift' claim did not account for these paths — going-forward writes are now consistent.
storeManagement.warehouseTransfers: PUT /transfers/:id/dispatch and /receive now correctly update materials.current_stock in the same transaction as the stock_ledger insert (previously silently no-op on current_stock — fixed 2026-08-20).
storeManagement.rejectionsAndRtv: 2026-08-20 audit: genuinely wired — Dispatch RTV calls the live store.js route (not the dead security.js one), status correctly flips to 'Dispatched Out', no missing-vendor crash risk. No bug found.
storeManagement.storeReturnsSrv: 2026-08-20: creating + inspecting a return correctly credits current_stock, writes a real stock_ledger 'return' row, and produces a real listed SRV voucher. 'Original Indent/Issue Ref' is intentionally optional. FIXED: POST /returns now caps cumulative returned qty per indent+material at indent_items.required_qty, rejecting over-return with a clear error.
storeManagement.installedAssetsDigitalTwin: 2026-08-20 audit: genuinely real, DB-backed (installed_assets table), sortable, with a working Retire/Failure action that writes back and logs an asset_events audit row — confirmed not a placeholder tab.

gatePass.lifecycle: Create (inward/outward/RTV), list open passes, mark-out, edit — all wired end to end as of 2026-08-20 (edit route existed server-side but had no UI button until this session; also had a missing permission guard, and allowed creation against a Cancelled PO — all 3 fixed). Note: linkage to GRN is optional today, not enforced — flagged as an open process question.
gatePass.knownDeadCode: security.js's POST /rtv-pass is unreachable — Security.jsx never calls it, the live RTV-dispatch path is store.js's own route. Left as-is, flagged for future cleanup/consolidation.

qualityControl.scope: Dual-purpose: incoming-GRN inspection (accept/reject reconciliation against grn_items) AND a standalone lab-testing module (Process/Final/Customer tests on Reels) — not purely one or the other.
qualityControl.grnInspectFix: 2026-08-20: quality.js's grn-inspect route was re-applying the FULL received qty to stock/rejections on top of what GRN intake already applied (double-count on every QC decision) — fixed to diff against the existing decision and apply only the delta. Quality.jsx was also not sending the GRN line-item id, so the backend update silently no-op'd — fixed. A fake-fallback that could submit a QC decision against fabricated data when the real GRN failed to load was removed.
qualityControl.designNote: QC is currently a correction layer, not a mandatory gate — accept/reject is already decided and applied at GRN-intake time, before QC ever reviews it. If 'nothing counts as stock until QC signs off' is the intended business rule, that needs a flow/schema change, not a patch — flagged, not implemented.

apSettlement.billing: Vendor bills can now only be booked against a GRN's ACCEPTED (post-QC) value, not the PO's ordered value — guard added in both finance.js POST /bills (2026-08-20) and, more critically, in purchase.js POST /po/:id/bill (the actual live route the Purchase module uses — previously silently defaulted the taxable amount to the full PO value when omitted, now requires it explicitly and validates against GRN accepted value).
apSettlement.payments: Double-payment guard verified solid (row-locked balance check, no race condition). Fixed: AP Ledger (GET /ap) had a join-fan-out inflating totals for vendors with multiple bills+POs; vendor-payments total was summed over a paginated page instead of the full result set.
apSettlement.segregationOfDuties: Bill-approval and payment-disbursement both only require role_level 3 with no check against the same person doing both — no maker-checker, unlike the pattern already used for customer-payment confirmation elsewhere in this codebase. Flagged, needs a policy decision.

indentIssuance.lifecycle: Draft -> Submitted -> L1 Approved -> Approved -> Partially Issued -> Issued -> Closed (Rejected/Cancelled). Tier-1 (<10k) auto-advances L1->Approved. Partial issues accurately tracked and auto-provisions Digital Twin assets. Edit permitted Draft through Partially Issued; Issued/Closed/Rejected/Cancelled are hard-blocked in BOTH the UI and the backend (Rejected/Cancelled were previously editable via direct API call — fixed 2026-08-20).
indentIssuance.routeOrdering: Cleaned up route precedence — calendar and my-acks routes verified working with HTTP 200.
indentIssuance.prToPoConversion: Two routes (POST /po with indent_id, and POST /indent/:id/convert-to-po) both now guard against double-converting the same indent and against converting a non-Approved indent (FOR UPDATE locked). Cancelling a linked PO now reverts the indent back to Approved (previously left it stuck at 'PO Created' forever). Line-item totals now consistently GST-exclusive across both conversion paths (convert-to-po was previously inflating totals 18% vs the other path). indentRequiredQty now exposed on GET /po/:id so the UI can show requested-vs-ordered qty (not yet consumed by any page).
indentIssuance.raiseModesAudit: 2026-08-20: all 5 mode cards (Plant Requisition, Direct PO, Cash Purchase, Store Issue/SIV, Delivery Challan/DC) validated against their own UI copy. Fixed: Cash Purchase mode was missing its promised paid vendor_bills record in the create-from-scratch flow (only existed in a separate convert-existing-indent endpoint); Store Issue (SIV) had a stale-stock-snapshot race condition allowing concurrent submits to drive stock negative (added FOR UPDATE locking); DC's 'Returnable' toggle never captured an expected_return_date (added, threaded to both DC-creation paths); Required-By-Date and Plant-Section/Area were labelled required (*) but under-enforced client/server-side (both now enforced both sides, all modes). Flagged, not fixed: the '3-tier L1 Store -> L2 Dept Head -> L3 Plant Head' approval copy overstates the real mechanism — only 2 physical approval clicks exist, 'L2 Approved' is a dead status string never written.

reporting.crossDeptDeepDive: HR / Maintenance / Purchase / Finance / EHS deep-dive tabs in Reports.jsx — dept-scoped for L3, org-wide for L4+, drill-down to transaction level, CSV export, print

purchase.createPO: Server-side + client-side validation (vendor active, material active, qty>0, price>=0, GST 0-100, no duplicate materials, delivery-date sanity). Responsive 2-line cards layout.
purchase.autoFulfillment: PO status automatically transitions to 'Partial' or 'Received' upon GRN item receipts.
purchase.editWindow: Edit/Modify PO button shown for any non-terminal status (all but Received/Closed/Cancelled), not just Draft.

vendors.access: Store Manager (role_level 3) has full create/update/delete access on vendors, backend (master.js requireLevel(3)) and frontend (no extra role gate on Vendors.jsx buttons) — verified 2026-08-20, was already correct.
vendors.excelImport: backend/scripts/import_vendors.js — dry-run-safe, insert-only, dedupes by GSTIN-else-normalized-name, plus POST /api/master/vendors/sync-excel + a Sync-from-Excel button in Vendors.jsx. Source file Projects_Requirement/8202026/VENDER NAME.xlsx has 42 unique vendor names only (no GSTIN/address/bank columns). Logic-verified, not yet run live (no DB access from build sandbox).

uiComponents.searchableSelect: frontend/src/components/SearchableSelect.jsx — universal typeahead combobox (search-as-you-type, arrow-key nav, Enter/Escape, first-letter jump, code/subtext/badge display, clear button, checkmark on selection). Rolled out across every dropdown in Purchase.jsx, Indent.jsx, Store.jsx, Materials.jsx, Users.jsx, and (as of 2026-08-20) Inventory.jsx — every dropdown in the app now has typeahead search + keyboard nav.

inventoryPage.syncWithMaterials: 2026-08-20: confirmed Inventory.jsx/inventory.js has no independent stock recalculation — reads and maintains the same canonical materials.current_stock column transactionally (FOR UPDATE + matching stock_ledger write in the same transaction on every route) as everywhere else in the app. Cannot disagree with Materials.jsx for the same material. No drift risk, no fix needed.

exports.vendorNameCoverage: 2026-08-20: audited every excel/CSV export in the app. Added Vendor Name + GSTIN columns to the Enterprise Inventory Excel export (inventoryExcelExporter.js) and Vendor Name + PO Number(s) to the Indents CSV export (reports.js) and to Indent.jsx's own client-side CSV export. PO list/detail, Purchase Deep-Dive, and P2P Pipeline exports already had vendor name. Pure consumption/KPI rollup exports (StoreDeptReports.jsx etc.) correctly left without a vendor column — no vendor relationship in that data.

dailyStockRollover.invariant: Opening = current_stock - today_received + today_issued; Closing = current_stock; tomorrow's Opening = today's Closing. Enforced in master.js across GET /materials, GET /materials/:id, GET /materials/:id/stock-summary.
dailyStockRollover.correctness: 2026-08-20 re-audit: GET /materials/:id was using a narrow transaction_type whitelist instead of != 'opening' like the other two endpoints, silently excluding 9+ real transaction types from ProductDetailModal.jsx's daily figures. Fixed to match. No date/timezone bug found (all stock_ledger writes use Postgres CURRENT_DATE server-side).

gitCheckpoint.status: Blocked 2026-08-20. A full git add -A + commit of all outstanding work (this session's fixes plus previously-uncommitted work) was prepared and safety-reviewed (no secrets/.env, no oversized binaries, .gitignore's exclusion of checkpoint.json correctly respected) but cannot complete: .git/index.lock exists and cannot be removed from the build sandbox (rm/mv both fail 'Operation not permitted', no live git process found running) — almost certainly a Windows-side lock on the user's own machine (an open git GUI/editor, or an antivirus scan). User needs to close whatever has the repo open, or delete the lock file, before the prepared commit can run.
gitCheckpoint.pushNote: Even once committed locally, git push to origin (github.com/metapharsic/mill.git) cannot happen from this sandbox or the device bridge — neither has network access to GitHub or the user's credentials. Push needs to run from the user's own machine.

navigationAndPlantSections.sidebar: NAV config in Sidebar.jsx reorganized into: Materials & Inventory (Materials Master, Raw Material Store, Inventory), Store & Indent (Store Management, Store Dashboard, Indent/PIIMAS), and a unified Plant & Machines group (Machine Register + all 20 plant sections in process order). No hardcoded fields/columns -- groups are config-driven off the same NAV array permissions.js already filters.
navigationAndPlantSections.plantSectionEquipment: Equipment tab on PlantSection.jsx now has full CRUD: POST/PUT/DELETE all live under backend/src/routes/sections.js, all three gated by hasSectionWriteAccess() for the equipment's own section_code. Frontend has Add/Edit/Delete buttons wired to fetchAll() refresh after each action.
navigationAndPlantSections.machineRegister: Machines.jsx (global machine list, separate from per-section equipment) already had full Add/Edit/Deactivate/Restore -- verified, not modified this session.
navigationAndPlantSections.equipmentCrudGaps: Closed three gaps found across the equipment-add surfaces: (1) Materials.jsx's 'Add Machinery/Equipment/Roll Component' modal declared a `machines` state but never fetched it -- Machine Unit dropdown was permanently empty; added the missing fetch. (2) backend/src/routes/master.js had a duplicate/dead GET /section-equipment handler shadowing the real one (Express uses first match), which returned incomplete fields (no bearingSize/lockNut/etc) -- removed the dead stub. navigationAndPlantSections.stillOpenDecisions: Three architectural items flagged but NOT changed, need a product decision before touching: (a) three parallel machine/equipment tables -- section_equipment (Store/Materials), equipment (Maintenance, kept in sync by tag-code match now but still a separate table), machines (global registry, no section link at all); (b) Machine Unit dropdown has no real DB relationship to Plant Section -- nothing stops picking a mismatched pair; (c) legacy `sections` table still sits alongside `plant_sections`, joined together via OR-conditions in several master.js queries.

openItems.status: RESOLVED 2026-08-23: unlink is blocked on this mount for ANY process (confirmed it's the sandbox's own restriction, not an external lock-holder) -- but renaming the lock file to a new, not-yet-existing name succeeds. openItems.item: QC is a correction layer, not a mandatory hold-back gate on materials.current_stock

openItems.impact: goods are counted as usable stock before any formal QC sign-off
openItems.status: flagged 2026-08-20, needs a decision on whether stock should be held out of current_stock until QC approves — that would require a schema/flow change, not a patch

openItems.status: flagged 2026-08-20, needs a policy decision (different user required, or a higher role level for disbursement)
